diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_launch_template.ng duplicates the launch-template references already used by the Auto Scaling group.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng duplicates its implicit reference to the node role ARN.
The explicit dependency from :resource.kubernetes_config_map.aws-auth to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp duplicates its implicit dependency through the configured Kubernetes provider.

The node groups use the node IAM role, but neither node-group resource waits for the X-Ray policy attachment. When App Mesh is enabled, nodes may start before the role receives the permissions needed by the X-Ray daemon.

The managed node group uses the node IAM role, but it does not wait for the X-Ray policy attachment. When App Mesh is enabled, nodes may start before the role receives the permissions needed by the X-Ray daemon.
